caption: The drawing depicts a single high-ankle buttoned boot positioned in profile, facing to the right. The boot is predominantly light blue or pale gray in color, with a yellowish or tan trim around the top edge. Along the side of the boot, there is a vertical row of metallic buttons and buttonholes, fastened with what appears to be a light brown or tan strip. The heel of the boot is short and broad, colored in a reddish-brown shade, distinct from the rest of the boot. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or patterns present, focusing attention solely on the boot.
title: Woman's Shoe
